urls.title: URLs to fetch
urls.description: Pages to retrieve. Each URL produces one dataset item and one charge (failures are free).

browserId.title: Browser ID
browserId.description: Which Ceki browser to drive. Find it in your Ceki dashboard. Overrides the CEKI_BROWSER_ID environment variable.

waitUntil.title: Wait strategy
waitUntil.description: How long to wait after navigation before extracting. `selector` additionally waits for the CSS selector below.
enumTitles: Network idle — waits for XHR/fetch to settle
Specific selector — waits for an element to appear

waitSelector.title: Wait selector
waitSelector.description: CSS selector that must exist before extraction. Used only when the wait strategy is `selector`.

networkIdleMs.title: Network idle window (ms)
networkIdleMs.description: How long the page must have no new resource requests to count as idle. Used only with the `networkidle` strategy.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per URL (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Upper bound for navigation plus waiting for a single URL. A URL that exceeds it is reported as failed and does not stop the run.

returnFields.title: What to return
returnFields.description: Fields to extract from each page. Cookies and screenshots are best-effort; HTML is always available.

fullPageScreenshot.title: Full-page screenshot
fullPageScreenshot.description: Capture the entire scrollable page instead of just the visible viewport.

keepSession.title: Keep the session warmed
keepSession.description: Leave the browser session alive after the run so the next run resumes onto the same warmed profile. Disable only for one-shot runs that should leave nothing behind.
